name: preview-ribbon
title: Preview ribbon
description: Keeps a draft label visible within preview screenshots. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

meta.whenToUse: Draft status should travel with the work, including into the screenshots that leave the review.
meta.notFor: A dismissible banner. There is no dismiss action by design: a ribbon that can be closed is absent from the screenshot that needed it.
pitfalls: Position belongs to you. Without sticky or fixed positioning from your own className, the ribbon scrolls away with the page.
meta.contract: Keeps a draft label visible within preview screenshots. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

props.name: labels
props.description: Localized draft label and supporting context.

properties.name: description
properties.default: 'A private preview, not the finished thing.'

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows the system preference.

defaults.labels.description: 'A private preview, not the finished thing.'

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; lifecycle messages use polite announcements. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/preview-ribbon.md. Consumers own authorization.
